svg.title: Valmet DNA: header and status telegram
svg.desc: The 126-byte status telegram of frame 1 of valmet-dna-multicast-anon.pcap, 32 bits per row: the 12-byte header with the magic AB 01, the source node 0x801D, the destination 0x00FF, the length 124 and the message kind 0x00000FFF, then the fields the crate names, the node address 10.0.2.1, the ten-byte BCD clock with its fraction and its year little-endian (2020-01-01 00:00:00.0000, weekday 3, rewritten by the anonymization), the node number 0x1D, the multicast group 239.0.171.1 and the two microsecond counters 0x540F5BF1 and 0x54059702, with the bytes not identified summarised in between; ValmetDnaPacket keeps the header fields, the body and a StatusTelegram with the named values.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
